worker_claim.report: The intent record alone cannot safely establish ownership: the existing rework, publication, cleanup and recovery paths still mutate resources without generation-aware journaling. Completing those transitions and validating their crash ordering requires further implementation. The configured coverage run also failed the service retry IPC test with a busy response; that test passed in isolation.
worker_claim.summary: Persisted nonce-bearing execution resource intents at owner admission, preserving the intent across the admitted zero-delta retry replay. Documented that these intents are not ownership proofs and described the exclusive-writer trust boundary.
